biotools.summary: STCRpy is an open-source Python package for high-throughput T-cell receptor (TCR) structure handling and analysis. It facilitates TCR:peptide-MHC complex orientation calculation, root-mean-square-distance evaluation, interaction profiling, and machine learning dataset curation.
